candidates.title: AgentRisk: automation is not intent, measuring how fraud models fail legitimate AI shopping agents
candidates.summary:
Hi everyone, I am Rishabh. Here is a problem I keep coming back to: AI shopping agents now buy things on behalf of real people, and fraud models keep flagging them. To a fraud model, an agent looks like a bot: fast, systematic, no human hesitation. But automation is not intent. A legitimate agent completing a real purchase is not fraud, and every false decline is a real customer losing a real order.

AgentRisk is my attempt to measure that failure properly.
